in_arabic.name: هميرةتحت

in_urdu.name: ہُمیرتحت
in_urdu.meaning: ہُمیر تحتی معنی خیر اور سلام کی رہنمائی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہُمیرتحت ایک علم اسم مؤنث ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خیر اور سلام کی رہنمائی کرنا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی ہوا ہے، جو اس کی عظیم معنوی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हुमाय्रतहत
in_hindi.meaning: हुमाय्र तहट खैर और सलाम की रهنमाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुमाय्रतहत एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है, जो खैर और सलाम की रهنमाई करने वाली व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका विशेष महत्व है। इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जो इसकी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: هميرتحت
in_pashto.meaning: هميرتحت د خير او سول لپاره لارښود

data.cultural_impact: The name "Humayrataht" is of Arabic origin and can be traced back to the Quranic Arabic Language in Islamic tradition. Therefore, the name "Humayratah" can be interpreted as "the one who pleases" or "the one who delights." In popular culture, being praised for pleasing others or having the capacity to delight and bring happiness to those around us is considered a desirable trait.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritualcontext of Islam, the name "Humayratah" can be seen as a reminder of the importance of individual conduct and actions towards others, as prescribed in the Quran and Hadith. Muslims are encouraged to be kind, compassionate, and pleasing to others as a reflection of Allah's mercy and love towards creation. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "None of you will believe until you love me more than yourselves, and yourselves more than your loved ones, your families, and your children." (Bukhari) Therefore, the name "Humayratah" can be seen as a spiritual goal, a reminder for us to strive to please Allah by being good and kind to others, and to delight in doing good works and spreading kindness and love in the world.
